about.story: Glamour Salon & Spa was established in the heart of Murooj Al-Amir district, Tabuk, to be your ideal destination for beauty care. We believe every woman deserves to feel confident and radiant, which is why we offer comprehensive beauty services at the highest professional standards.
about.mission: Our mission is to deliver an exceptional beauty experience that combines quality, comfort, and fair pricing, while maintaining an elegant and welcoming environment for every client.
highlights: Certified beauty experts with over 10 years of experience
Clean, sanitized environment with strict hygiene standards
Transparent pricing with no hidden fees
